description: Source code for the WKExecutionContext class, which implements JavaScript execution context handling for WebKit in the Playwright project. Contains methods for evaluating JavaScript, retrieving properties, and managing object handles within a WebKit session.

classes.name: WKExecutionContext
classes.description: Implements JavaScript execution context delegate for WebKit, providing methods to evaluate scripts, get properties, and manage object handles within a WebKit session.

methods.name: rawEvaluateJSON
methods.description: Evaluates JavaScript expression and returns the result as JSON.

methods.name: rawEvaluateHandle
methods.description: Evaluates JavaScript expression and returns a handle to the result.

methods.name: evaluateWithArguments
methods.description: Calls a function with arguments within the execution context, returning the result.

methods.name: getProperties
methods.description: Retrieves properties of a JavaScript object handle.
